title: Request an exception to a security standard
summary: Ask for time-limited permission not to meet a mandatory requirement of a security standard, with the risk written down and accepted by the person who answers for it.

resources.title: Exception request template
resources.description: The questions the risk review asks, with a filled-in example.

prerequisites.title: The requirement id
prerequisites.description: The exact requirement you cannot meet, e.g. SEC-SCR-02.

prerequisites.title: A plan to meet it later
prerequisites.description: Exceptions are given for at most 12 months; say what you will do by then.

actors.name: You
actors.description: The engineer or product owner who needs the exception.

actors.name: Risk owner
actors.description: Head of the department that owns the application.

steps.title: Describe the exception and the risk
instructions: Name the standard, the requirement id and the application.
Explain why the requirement cannot be met now.
Describe what you do instead to reduce the risk.
Give the date by which you will meet the requirement.

steps.title: Submit the 'Security exception' request
instructions: Enter the risk owner of your department.

steps.title: Answer Security's questions
instructions: Read the questions on the request.
Update the template and reply on the request.

steps.title: Plan how to meet the requirement
instructions: Read why the exception was refused.
Plan the work to meet the requirement and agree a date with Security.

steps.title: Accept the risk
steps.description: The risk owner signs that the department accepts the risk until the end date.

steps.title: Record the exception with its end date
steps.description: Security adds the exception to the register and sets a reminder one month before it ends.
